PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior Business Analyst with 8+ years of experience delivering business transformation initiatives across Banking, Financial Services, Capital Markets, FinTech, and Digital Platforms. Expertise in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process modeling, API integrations, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, and end-to-end Agile project delivery.

raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Business Requirements Gathering & Analysis, Stakeholder Management, Business Process Modeling (BPMN, workflows, use cases), Business Case Development, Cost-Benefit & ROI Analysis, Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM), Gap Analysis, Executive Reporting & Presentations, Cross-Functional Collaboration (IT, Finance, Operations, Compliance), Market & Competitor Research, Risk Identification & Mitigation, KPI Design & Reporting, KYC & AML Workflows, Due Diligence, Order Management, Reconciliation, Data Analysis, UAT & SIT Coordination, Change Management, Regulatory Compliance.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Business Analysis Tools: JIRA, Confluence, MS Visio, Process Mapping | Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, SDLC, Waterfall | Analysis: SQL (Basic), API Integration, Data Analysis | Programming Exposure: Java (Basic), HTML | Reporting: Microsoft Excel (Advanced), MS PowerPoint, MS Office Suite | Documentation: BRD, FRD, User Stories, Functional Specifications, RTM
DOMAIN EXPERTISE
Banking, Retail Banking, Financial Services, Capital Markets, FinTech, Mutual Funds, Global Investments, Digital Banking, Regulatory Compliance, KYC, AML, Due Diligence, Fund Operations, Order Management, Reconciliation, Process Automation.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Business Analyst — India INX (India International Exchange, IFSC) Ltd. May 2026 – Present Project: BlackRock Global Mutual Fund Onboarding
Leading complete business analysis and solution design for onboarding global mutual funds into India's international investment ecosystem through India INX.
Led end-to-end onboarding journey design for Global Mutual Funds, coordinating across domestic and international stakeholders.
Gathered and documented business requirements from internal and external stakeholders through structured workshops and interviews.
Prepared BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, RTM, Process Flows, and supporting business documentation.
Designed the Investor Onboarding Journey and Distributor / Sub-Distributor onboarding workflows. • Defined KYC, AML, and Due Diligence processes for investor onboarding. • Designed Order Aggregation logic for Purchase, Redemption, and Switch transactions. • Designed end-to-end Fund Flow across Investors, Distributors, Standard Chartered Bank, India INX, JP Morgan, EBIX, and Global Fund Houses.
Led API integration efforts with Calastone and multiple external systems. • Designed Holdings Allocation process through EBIX and defined Order Management workflows. • Designed reconciliation processes covering Order, Fund, Holdings, and Unit Allocation reconciliation.
• Prepared comprehensive UAT test cases and supported SIT/UAT execution. • Coordinated with Technology, Operations, Compliance, Product, and Business teams; managed production issues,
defect resolution, and change requests.
Participated in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Grooming, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
Key Achievements • Successfully designed the complete end-to-end onboarding journey for Global Mutual Funds onto India INX. • Delivered business analysis for onboarding BlackRock Global Mutual Funds, a flagship regulatory and platform
initiative.
Reduced manual operational effort through targeted process automation, improving overall workflow efficiency. • Delivered complete functional documentation across multiple business modules, supporting scalable platform delivery.
Deputy Manager (Business Analyst) — ICICI Bank • Elicited, analyzed, and documented business requirements through stakeholder interviews and workshops; prioritized
May 2018 – May 2026
features and identified process-improvement opportunities aligned to growth goals.
Built business cases and financial models, including cost-benefit and ROI analyses, to support investment prioritization and go/no-go decisions.
Prepared and presented proposals, management reports, and data-backed recommendations to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Partnered with IT, Finance, and Operations to design, implement, and operationalize business solutions; tracked delivery, change adoption, and issue resolution.
Conducted market research and competitor benchmarking to identify customer trends, product/process opportunities, and risks.
Developed and maintained business process documentation, including process maps, flowcharts, and use cases, to improve clarity, controls, and throughput.
Identified business and operational risks; defined mitigation actions and contingency plans in line with governance standards.
Defined, monitored, and reported KPIs and operational metrics to drive continuous improvement and inform decision- making.
Led and coached a team of officers to strengthen credit card product knowledge, service quality, and escalation handling.
Deputed to Bhubaneswar to onboard and train new employees on credit card and retail liability processes; standardized product workflows and SOPs.
Key Achievements • Improved the iView banking application by implementing frontend and backend changes, boosting performance by
70% through optimization.
Enhanced business processes, leading to increased efficiency and productivity. • Deployed business solutions that drove revenue growth and improved profitability. • Led cross-functional teams to achieve business goals on schedule and within scope. • Fostered strong relationships with stakeholders across senior management and customer groups.
EXPERIENCE

iView, iCRM360, IVR, and CIB applications — frontend/backend improvements, system integration, and user experience enhancement.
